title: This Is How AI Reads YOUR Documents
hook: Your AI is lying to you. Here is why.
voiceover: Your AI is lying to you. Here is why. Most LLMs only know what they were trained on. Ask about your company docs, recent events, or private data — they hallucinate. RAG fixes this. Retrieval Augmented Generation. R is for Retrieve — pull the right documents. A is for Augment — inject them as context. G is for Generate — now your LLM answers from real data. When you ask a question, your query goes to a retrieval node. It searches a knowledge base — your actual documents. The top results get ranked by relevance. The most relevant docs are assembled into a context window. That context window is compressed and passed to the LLM. The LLM processes input tokens from your context, and streams out a grounded answer — one that cites real sources. Without RAG, you get generic answers. With RAG, you get sourced answers from your own data. The accuracy lift is dramatic. RAG grounds LLM answers in your real data. No fine-tuning. No hallucination. Just facts.
takeaway: RAG = LLM + Your Real Data. No fine-tuning needed.
